notes.title: Age of Respair Reaches 7,000 Wishlists — Thank You for the Amazing Support!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We wanted to take a moment to thank you all for the incredible support you've shown. In just two weeks, [b]Age of Respair[/b] has reached over [b]7,000[/b] wishlists! We’re truly grateful and excited to see the growing interest in the game.

The road ahead is still long, and we’re working hard to get the game ready for you. We know many of you are eager to jump into playtesting, and we're equally excited to share it! However, we also want to make sure the game is in the best shape possible before we let players experience it firsthand. That’s why our initial testing will be a closed playtest available to participants from our [url=https://discord.com/invite/zBhEdyXnAh]Discord community[/url], scheduled to start in early next year.

Thank you again for all your support! We’re looking forward to sharing more updates, development insights, and milestones with you along the way.

Warm regards,
Respair Games
